source.source_preconditions: The frozen original headers, tables and provenance are pinned by source bytes. All ten runs and all released frames are required. Source corruption/nonfinite measured voxels fail, without imputation or alternate dataset/run fallback. access_data.py is inert provenance and must not be executed by staging/oracle/verifier.

scope: Ten-person whole-run canonical-response FC sensitivity method control. Not a reproduction of Cole et al.'s FIR, simulation ground truth, HCP empirical result or condition-specific FC; neither estimate identifies intrinsic or causal coupling.

paper.role: Motivation for checking task-response model sensitivity, not an expected numerical finding.

cohort.membership: Closed literal participant/run membership in source_manifest.json; no fallback, selection by effect, available-case group averaging or duplicate alias normalization.

spatial.support: Use every in-FOV native voxel center whose squared physical distance from the center is <=64, no epsilon. Voxel world coordinates are ijk @ affine[:3,:3].T + affine[:3,3], using nibabel's selected original affine (sform code2 for this release) in original mm units. Distance association is (dx*dx+dy*dy)+dz*dz in float64. Sort C-flat support indices ascending. No nearest-voxel rescue, mask, smoothing, resampling or intensity-based selection. Empty support fails the source precondition.
spatial.mean: Decode effective NIfTI scaling into float64, select voxels in fixed support order, contiguous float64 mean per frame and ROI. Finite selected voxels and means are required; unselected intensities do not create an extra QC gate.
spatial.coordinate_boundary: MNI provenance is the released derivative description, not an independently verified nonlinear-registration or anatomical-localization result.

clock.evidence: All ten original NIfTI headers and BOLD sidecars agree on TR1.5 seconds. Header toffset is0. The retained half-TR origin0.75 is an explicit computational convention, not documented measured slice-time/stimulus alignment.
clock.frame_policy: Every released BOLD frame0..228; no dummy-volume trimming, slice-time shift, censoring or task-only frame mask. Keep raw header clock separate from the operational design clock.

design.motion_policy: Exactly one finite row per frame for all six literal columns; no missing-column omission, zero imputation, interpolation or nuisance selection. Preserve extra documentary columns but do not fit them.
design.events: Preserve all original rows and tokens. Require finite onset/duration, nonnegative duration, both and only declared conditions. Finite modulation if present, otherwise one. Sum amplitudes of duplicate (condition,onset,duration) triples with math.fsum in first-occurrence order while preserving every row receipt. Reject any onset before first_frame_time-24. No task-timing replacement or condition selection.

hrf.note: Use the public sampler including zero-duration-bin and finite-grid clipping behavior, one column per condition. No derivatives, FIR or cross-condition orthogonalization.

design.no_hidden_preprocessing: No full_rank singular-value shifting, column normalization, band-pass, extra detrend, whitening, regularization or zscore. The cosine nuisance projection supplies the high-pass component.

projection.dtype: C-contiguous float64 X and Y before SVD/projection; both ROI columns jointly
projection.retention: Strict singular_value>cutoff; rank deficiency is valid.
projection.residual: Y-U_keep@(U_keep.T@Y), both ROI columns jointly, the parentheses specify association.
projection.residual_df: T-rank, descriptive; no additional minimum-df acceptance target
projection.independence: Oracle and grader share the declared solver, HRF sampler and NumPy/SciPy primitives. They independently authenticate/decode source and enumerate ROI supports and implement replay. This is not independent verification of the mathematical validity of those shared dependencies.

activity.constant: If all entries are exactly equal, return exact zero centered vector/norm.
activity.centering: For a nonconstant finite vector x, scale=max(abs(x)); center the normalized vector using math.fsum(x/scale)/T, then return centered normalized vector times scale. Compute L2 by scale-first sum of squares. No epsilon denominator.
activity.active: T>=2 and centered_L2(canonical_residual)>threshold for each ROI/model; same raw scale for both models.
activity.authority: Canonical support/rank comes only from authenticated sources. Harmless within-tolerance jitter in an inactive submitted residual does not activate it. This numerical resolution convention is not a biological QC criterion or arbitrary-signal-unit invariance.

inference.authority: Directly source-bound accepted residuals are the sole downstream numerical primitive. Compute person r,z,paired z contrast and all group values from one replay. CSV/JSON scalar receipts, raw Y and design receipts are never used to refit or define another endpoint.
inference.pearson: Accurately scale-center accepted residuals as specified under activity. Compute math.fsum(x_center_scaled*y_center_scaled)/(stable_L2(x_center_scaled)*stable_L2(y_center_scaled)). Both canonical ROI supports must be active. Clamp only an arithmetic excursion <=1e-12 outside [-1,1]; larger/nonfinite values fail.
inference.fisher: atanh(clip(r,-0.999,0.999)); report unclipped signed r separately
inference.group: For each model, tanh(math.fsum(all ten person z)/10), equal person weights; also report the signed difference between these two r-scale means, separately from mean paired z change.
inference.paired: d=z_nuisance-z_glover; mean=math.fsum(d)/10; sample SD via exactconstant guard and accurate centered norm/sqrt(9); SE=SD/sqrt(10); two-sided t with df9; CI=mean +/- scipy.stats.t.ppf(.975,9)*SE.
inference.zero_variance: If SE=0, status=zero_variance, CI=[mean,mean], t and p null; no infinite JSON or fabricated p-value.
inference.incomplete: Keep every participant, all finite residuals and explicit inactive-pair status with null r/z/d. Each model group needs all ten defined model results; paired inference needs all ten pairs. Otherwise report incomplete_support, expected/defined counts and null numerical summaries. Never available-case average.
inference.boundary: A signed descriptive change and conventional between-person CI in this convenience cohort is not proof of artifact removal, true coupling, a population effect or uncertainty over model choice. No required direction, significance, minimum change or nonconstant person pattern.

tolerances.active_centered_fidelity: Use a common prescale to accurately center accepted and canonical residuals, compare centered difference L2 <=1e-6*canonical centered L2, with no absolute floor.
tolerances.exact: Literal identities, shapes, counts, Boolean masks, canonical rank/activity and statuses; no broadcast matching or numeric aliases for literal subject/ROI/model/column names.
